import requests
import json
import uuid
import sys
import time

BASE = "{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}"
HEADERS = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}

def test_authorization_null():
    """Test 1: Authorization=null on /v2/vectordb/roles/drop"""
    role_name = f"test_role_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    
    # First create a role
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/v2/vectordb/roles/create", 
                      json={"roleName": role_name}, headers=HEADERS)
    print(f"Create role response: {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    
    # Now try to drop with Authorization=null
    payload = {"roleName": role_name}
    bad_headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": None}
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/v2/vectordb/roles/drop", 
                      json=payload, headers=bad_headers)
    print(f"Drop role with Authorization=null: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}")
    
    code = r.json().get('code', -1) if r.text else -1
    if code == 0:
        print("[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] Server accepted Authorization=null on roles/drop")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        print(f"OK - Server properly rejected Authorization=null (code={code})")
    
    # Clean up - try with proper auth
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/v2/vectordb/roles/drop", 
                      json={"roleName": role_name}, headers=HEADERS)
    print(f"Cleanup drop role: {r.status_code} {r.text[:100]}")
    sys.exit(0)
